brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent full-depth bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full) on two connected cells provide open trays that function as utensil holders. House rules capped and locked.
Placed bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full (2 x hex-bin-full).

Configurator checks fit/collision only. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; the system cannot verify watertightness, sealing, or layer-line porosity. Shape helps contain items but waterproof claim cannot be verified.

Configurator checks fit only, not material/heat/chemical resistance. Printed plastic's dishwasher safety depends on filament choice (PLA/PETG etc.), temperature and food-safety, none verified by the build. Do not assume dishwasher safe.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-cell base with two full-depth bins for utensil storage, capped and joint-locked. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe cannot be met by geometry alone - they are material/process-dependent and unverified by the configurator, so marked unmet.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
